L129.formula: bound=matching receptor at step1; relay=bound AND downstream at step2; response=relay at step3
L129.parameters: two boolean switches; steps0–3; no physical time or concentration
L129.assumptions: One membrane-impermeant ligand; one selected relay; binary teaching states
L129.limitations: Not a quantitative receptor-occupancy or molecular pathway model; other ligands use internal receptors.

L130.formula: weak peaks at20,70 ms; strong at10,30,50,70,90 ms; each spike shape [-70,-30,30,-20,-80,-70] mV over6 samples
L130.parameters: time0–100 ms,1 ms sample; process stage0–4 independent of trace time
L130.assumptions: Same stylised neuron and conditions; frequency20 or50 Hz; no recruitment model
L130.limitations: Not a membrane differential-equation model; marker is process stage not physical propagation speed.

L131.parameters: x0=10 arbitrary units; k=.3,d=0 or k=.6,d=1;10 steps; k range0–.6;d0–2
L131.assumptions: Linear correction of signed deviation; fixed target0; first missing history uses initial value
L131.limitations: No human time, physiological concentration, secretion kinetics or diagnostic interpretation.

L132.formula: APC>=step1;helper>=step2 if present;plasma>=step3 if helper;antibody>=step4 if helper;killing>=step4 if preactivated CD8 present
L132.parameters: two booleans;five logical stages;original culture examples use relative antibody units and killed/100 targets
L132.assumptions: Selected T-dependent B response; CD8 availability explicitly preactivated and independent switch
L132.limitations: Not immune efficacy, infection risk or full activation network; no medication or individual advice.
